Also A087003’s published prime-power formula (-1+(-1)^e)/2 for odd primes is wrong for odd e>1: at 3^3=27 it gives -1 although its name and listed term give 0. agreement: Offsets 0/0; all 74 common listed terms agree at n=0..73. A346663 publishes agreement through n=2435 (2436 terms), then 2436 versus 2434 at n=2436.

Hence P has at least two real roots and cannot have 2436 nonreal roots. This independently refutes the identity; the exact count 2434 and first-failure claim are sourced to the OEIS record, not claimed to be proved by this sign test.

agreement: Offsets 0/1. Same-index equality has zero initial matches: A007094(1)=1 while A039155(1)=0. Even after correcting the positional alignment to A007094(n)=A039155(n+1), there are only 64 matches, n=0..63; A007094(64)=100 but A039155(65)=89.
novelty: Neither record asserts the proposed equality. This absence is not evidence of novelty: the candidate is directly false in its live listed data.
integrity: Before 89, eligible decimal numbers have no 8 or 9 and imitate octal digit strings. The value 89 introduces one of each digit and is allowed by A039155, but cannot be an octal digit string. Independent enumeration reproduces the mismatch.

agreement: Offsets 3/0; literal same-index comparison fails at n=3 (3 versus 6). The packet drops two terms from each positional list, giving 64 matches A213222(n+3)=A265283(n), n=2..65.

agreement: Offsets 1/1; all 105 common listed terms agree at n=1..105.
